description: This file implements a Bluetooth plugin for a Thunder-based platform, providing methods for device discovery, connection management, property handling, and event processing, interfacing with the Bluetooth Manager API.

classes.name: Bluetooth
classes.description: Main class implementing Bluetooth plugin functionalities, managing device discovery, connection, properties, and event handling.

methods.name: Bluetooth
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Bluetooth plugin, registering methods, and setting up Bluetooth Manager.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a JSON string.

methods.name: getStatusSupport
methods.description: Determines the Bluetooth hardware and software status.

methods.name: isAdapterDiscoverable
methods.description: Checks if the Bluetooth adapter is discoverable.

methods.name: startDeviceDiscovery
methods.description: Starts device discovery with specified timeout and profile.

methods.name: stopDeviceDiscovery
methods.description: Stops ongoing device discovery.

methods.name: startDiscoveryTimer
methods.description: Schedules a timer to stop discovery after a specified period.

methods.name: stopDiscoveryTimer
methods.description: Cancels the discovery timer.

methods.name: onDiscoveryTimer
methods.description: Callback invoked when discovery timer expires to stop discovery.

methods.name: getDiscoveredDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of discovered Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of paired Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: getConnectedDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: setDeviceConnection
methods.description: Connects or disconnects a device based on device ID, enable flag, and device type.

methods.name: setAudioStream
methods.description: Sets the audio stream type for a device.

methods.name: setDevicePairing
methods.description: Pairs or unpairs a device.

methods.name: setBluetoothEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: setBluetoothDiscoverable
methods.description: Sets the Bluetooth adapter discoverable mode with timeout.

methods.name: setBluetoothProperties
methods.description: Sets Bluetooth adapter properties like name.

methods.name: getBluetoothProperties
methods.description: Retrieves Bluetooth adapter properties.

methods.name: setAudioControlCommand
methods.description: Sends media control commands to a device.

methods.name: setEventResponse
methods.description: Responds to Bluetooth events like pairing or connection requests.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a device.
